rule: A row is included only when a full text or a publisher page was opened on this date. PDFs are not stored in the repo. abstract means the page showed the abstract, not the article body.

papers.authors: James Bergstra, Yoshua Bengio
papers.title: Random Search for Hyper-Parameter Optimization
papers.use: Baseline for tuning. Most hyperparameters do not matter, and which ones matter changes with the data.

papers.authors: Jasper Snoek, Hugo Larochelle, Ryan P. Adams
papers.title: Practical Bayesian Optimization of Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.use: Gaussian-process tuning when one evaluation is expensive. Acquisition accounts for cost and parallel trials.

papers.authors: Lisha Li, Kevin Jamieson, Giulia DeSalvo, Afshin Rostamizadeh, Ameet Talwalkar
papers.title: Hyperband: A Novel Bandit-Based Approach to Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.use: Early-stop random configurations when a cheap prefix predicts the final score.

papers.authors: Bernd Bischl, Martin Binder, Michel Lang, Tobias Pielok, Jakob Richter, Stefan Coors, Janek Thomas, Theresa Ullmann, Marc Becker, Anne-Laure Boulesteix, Difan Deng, Marius Lindauer
papers.title: Hyperparameter Optimization: Foundations, Algorithms, Best Practices, and Open Challenges
papers.use: Nested validation. The score used to pick a configuration is not the score used to report it.

papers.authors: Ilya Loshchilov, Frank Hutter
papers.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
papers.use: Weight decay and L2 are not the same knob under Adam.

papers.authors: Jordan Hoffmann, Sebastian Borgeaud, Arthur Mensch, et al.
papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.use: Under a fixed compute budget, parameters and tokens scale together.

papers.authors: Margaret Li, Sneha Kudugunta, Luke Zettlemoyer
papers.title: (Mis)Fitting: A Survey of Scaling Laws
papers.use: Fitted scaling exponents move when the optimizer, checkpoint, or parameter count changes.

papers.authors: Ayan Sengupta, Yash Goel, Tanmoy Chakraborty
papers.title: How to Upscale Neural Networks with Scaling Law? A Survey and Practical Guidelines
papers.use: Sparse, mixture-of-experts, retrieval, and multimodal models leave the dense-language-model power law.

papers.authors: Alexandra Volkova, Mher Safaryan, Christoph H. Lampert, Dan Alistarh
papers.title: Towards Robust Scaling Laws for Optimizers
papers.use: Share scaling exponents across optimizers. Give each optimizer its own scale factor.

papers.authors: Edward J. Hu, Yelong Shen, Phillip Wallis, Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Yuanzhi Li, Shean Wang, Lu Wang, Weizhu Chen
papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.use: Adapt a pretrained model with low-rank increments. It does not create the pretrained model.

papers.authors: Menglin Yang, Jialin Chen, Jinkai Tao, et al.
papers.title: Low-Rank Adaptation for Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Review
papers.use: Map of LoRA beyond language models. Formulas stay with Hu et al. 2021.

papers.authors: Nusrat Jahan Prottasha, et al.
papers.title: PEFT A2Z: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Survey for Large Language and Vision Models
papers.use: Name list of parameter-efficient methods as of 2025. Not a formula source.

papers.authors: Rafael Rafailov, Archit Sharma, Eric Mitchell, Stefano Ermon, Christopher D. Manning, Chelsea Finn
papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.use: Preference tuning as a classification loss. Requires a model that already generates and a set of pairwise preferences.

papers.authors: Ashish Vaswani, et al.
papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.use: Architecture the later adaptation and scaling papers assume. The arXiv id was confirmed by retrieval on this date; the PDF was not re-read.

papers.authors: Guy Emerson
papers.title: What are the Goals of Distributional Semantics?
papers.use: Distributional semantics needs a top-down goal. Downstream scores alone do not say where the field is going.

papers.authors: Gemma Boleda
papers.title: Distributional Semantics and Linguistic Theory
papers.use: Graded corpus-derived word vectors, reviewed for semantic change, polysemy, composition, and the grammar interface.

papers.authors: Jeffrey Pennington, Richard Socher, Christopher D. Manning
papers.title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
papers.use: Linear analogies come from a global co-occurrence regression, not from a local window average.

papers.authors: Emily M. Bender, Alexander Koller
papers.title: Climbing towards NLU: On Meaning, Form, and Understanding in the Age of Data
papers.use: Training on form alone does not establish that a system has meaning.

papers.authors: Marianna Apidianaki
papers.title: From Words to Instances and Back: A Survey of Approaches to Meaning Representation and Interpretation
papers.use: Token vectors and word-type meaning are different layers. Current work moves between them.

papers.authors: Olivier Morin
papers.title: Reasons to be fussy about cultural evolution
papers.use: States the split between cultural attraction and selectionist cultural evolution without collapsing them.

papers.authors: Andrew Buskell
papers.title: What are cultural attractors?
papers.use: An attractor is a bias in transformation outcomes, not an object stored in a graph.

papers.authors: Thom Scott-Phillips, Stefaan Blancke, Christophe Heintz
papers.title: Four misunderstandings about cultural attraction
papers.use: Attraction theory is a causal research program about changing type frequencies, not a synonym for replication plus selection.

papers.authors: Alberto Acerbi, Mathieu Charbonneau, Helena Miton, Thom Scott-Phillips
papers.title: Culture without copying or selection
papers.use: Population stability can come from convergent transformation with neither copying nor selection.

papers.authors: David Kempe, Jon Kleinberg, Eva Tardos
papers.title: Maximizing the Spread of Influence through a Social Network
papers.use: Submodular influence maximization on a known network. A different problem from copy fidelity.
